timeline.summary: IFB Industries Limited’s shareholders approved Mrs. Sreedevi Pillai’s re-appointment as Independent Director via postal ballot on 22-Apr-2026 with 99.9% votes.
Bikramjit Nag declared no encumbrance on IFB Industries shares held by him or persons acting in concert for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
CB Management Services merged into MUFG Intime India, continuing RTA services for IFB Industries seamlessly.
IFB Industries reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,498.20 Cr and PAT of ₹42.67 Cr
IFB Industries Limited held its 50th Annual General Meeting on 29 July 2026, where all resolutions were approved by shareholders with requisite majority.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,584.74 Cr (+18.4% YoY), net profit ₹43.05 Cr (+64.6% YoY).
IFB Industries Limited held its 50th Annual General Meeting on 29 July 2026.
IFB Industries Limited held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 14, 2026, reporting 16.65% YoY revenue growth to ₹1,529 Cr and PBDIT margin improvement to 5.79%
